name: Verifying
description: Responsible for validating and assessing the novelty of generated peptide sequences by searching them against local copies of established biological databases and retrieving relevant annotations.

tools.description: Searches a locally downloaded copy of the SwissProt database (no internet call, no BLAST+ binary required) for the closest matching known protein, reporting %identity via local alignment.

Searches a locally downloaded copy of the DBAASP database (no internet call, no BLAST+ binary required) for the closest matching known antimicrobial peptide, reporting %identity via local alignment. A sequence with no close match is reported as novel.

context: This verification module evaluates the output produced by the generation module, translating natural language validation requests from the planning phase into structured database queries.
Both verification tools search local CSV copies of their respective databases -- no internet access or external API key is used at query time.
This verification step should be executed as the final stage in the pipeline.
